resources.string:
To use AI voice assistant and image recognition features, you need to configure at least one API key.

Supported services:
• Google Gemini
• OpenAI
• Anthropic Claude
• Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint
You can get an API key from the website of the AI service you choose.
Configure text-to-speech output. The app uses your phone’s text-to-speech engine.
Voice quality and language support depend on the speech engine and voices installed on your phone.
